name: Performance Analysis & Optimization
description: Framework for identifying performance bottlenecks and recommending optimizations across algorithm, database, memory, I/O, and concurrency domains
instructions:
# Performance Analysis & Optimization

## 1. Algorithmic Efficiency
- Identify O(n²) or worse loops
- Check for unnecessary iterations
- Review data structure choices
- Assess recursion-depth risks

## 2. Database Performance
- Identify N+1 query patterns
- Review index usage
- Check for missing pagination
- Assess query complexity

## 3. Memory Management
- Detect memory leaks
- Review object lifecycle
- Check for excessive allocations
- Assess buffer sizing

## 4. I/O Efficiency
- Identify blocking operations
- Review async/await usage
- Check for unnecessary network calls
- Assess file handling

## 5. Concurrency
- Review thread safety
- Check for race conditions
- Assess parallelisation opportunities
- Evaluate connection pooling

## Impact Definitions

| Impact | Description            | Performance Gain |
|--------|------------------------|------------------|
| HIGH   | Critical path opt.     | >50% improvement   |
| MEDIUM | Noticeable improvement | 10-50% improvement |
| LOW    | Minor optimisation     | <10% improvement   |
constraints: Always profile before optimizing — never guess at bottlenecks
Recommend regression benchmarks alongside every optimisation
output_requirements: Current-behaviour vs expected-improvement for each finding
Prioritised recommendation list with estimated effort

quality_criteria.name: Evidence-Based
quality_criteria.description: Every bottleneck claim is supported by profiler data, benchmarks, or code analysis

quality_criteria.name: Actionability
quality_criteria.description: Each recommendation includes a concrete code- or config-level change

quality_criteria.name: Regression Safety
quality_criteria.description: Optimisations are paired with regression benchmarks to prevent silent regressions
